title.zh: 局部排他支持推至全部叶项

statement.en: Where each part's footprint lies within its whole's and the two parts' footprints share nothing, a plan realized with each leaf's draw supported by its own configuration's footprint has all its leaves draw on supported by the root's footprint: nothing repeats, and everything lies within it.
statement.zh: 凡每个部分的足迹在其整体的足迹之内、两个部分的足迹无共同处，一个以每片叶所汲取者被其自身构形的足迹支持而实现的计划，其诸叶所汲取者皆被根的足迹支持：无重复，且皆在其内。

laws.en: A configuration realizes a plan, a finite binary nesting of leaves, where it holds together parts realizing the plan's two sides, down to leaves read at the parts; a footprint supports a list where the list repeats nothing and each member lies within the footprint.
laws.zh: 一个构形实现一个计划（叶的有限二叉嵌套），是指它把实现计划两侧的部分合在一起，直到在部分处读出的叶；足迹支持一个列表，是指该列表无重复且每个成员都在足迹之内。

laws.en: For a plan realized at a configuration with each leaf's list supported by its leaf configuration's footprint: where each part's footprint lies within its whole's, everything the leaves draw on, joined in order, lies within the root's footprint.
laws.zh: 一个计划在某构形处实现、每片叶的列表都被其叶构形的足迹支持时：凡每个部分的足迹在其整体的足迹之内，诸叶所汲取者按序相接，皆在根的足迹之内。

laws.en: Where moreover the two parts of each whole share no footprint, what the leaves draw on repeats nothing, so the root's footprint supports it.
laws.zh: 若每个整体的两个部分的足迹又无共同处，诸叶所汲取者无重复，故根的足迹支持它。

laws.en: Support at the root does not give realization: where no whole holds any part, the root's footprint supports what a plan of two empty leaves draws on, and the plan is not realized.
laws.zh: 根处的支持不给出实现：没有整体合持任何部分时，根的足迹支持由两片空叶组成的计划所汲取者，而该计划不被实现。

hypotheses.zh: 足迹的 PartsWithin 与 PartsApart；计划被实现，每片叶读作 Supports。
hypotheses.en: PartsWithin and PartsApart of the footprint; the plan realized with each leaf read as Supports.

does_not_show.en: Support by the root's footprint does not give a realization of the plan; the converse needs more structure.
does_not_show.zh: 根足迹的支持不给出计划的实现；逆向需要更多结构。

detail.zh: 这里只从已实现计划推得支持；一般反向实现不能省去额外结构。
detail.en: This direction derives support from a realized plan; converse realization cannot omit additional structure.

validation_scope.en: Machine-checked by the consolidated core checker: Becoming.JointPlans and Becoming.Composition are bound to receipts in becoming/becoming-checks, and every cited declaration has an empty axiom report. The periphery's earlier form (deeper/ExplanatoryFootprints, its receipt in deeper/explanatory-global-realization-checks) is a provenance reference.
validation_scope.zh: 合并核心检查器实查：Becoming.JointPlans 与 Becoming.Composition 绑定 becoming/becoming-checks 中的回执，所引声明公理报告全空。外围的早先形式（deeper/ExplanatoryFootprints，其回执在 deeper/explanatory-global-realization-checks）为来源引用。

next_delta.en: Reuse for nested exclusive requests, and an account of its own for footprints that are shared or renewed.
next_delta.zh: 复用于嵌套的排他请求；可共享、可更新的足迹另作其自身的说明。

correspondence.zh: 资源身份与排他性是局部模型前提，不是生成的一般原语。
correspondence.en: Resource identity and exclusivity are local model premises, not universal primitives of generativity.

detail.zh: 同一共同支持问题的不同表达，不计作已证明的相互推广。
detail.en: Different representations of shared support; neither is registered as a proved generalization of the other.

history.zh: 2026-10-08：迁移既有成果身份与范围；不新增定理，不移动原始资料。
history.en: 2026-10-08: migrated existing result identity and scope; no new theorem or relocated source.

history.zh: 2026-10-14，整合 I3（Ren：“a lot proofs are probably not integrated”）：在脊柱上陈述。新的核心模块 Becoming.Composition（只导入 Becoming.Likeness）加入一配置把两配置作为部分共同持有的关系（JointFrame），以及联合检验、联合相同、紧致、嵌套计划与足迹；Becoming.CompositionBridge 把 ExplanatoryJointness 与 ExplanatoryFootprints 读作实例。若每一部分的足迹在其整体之内且两部分的足迹不相交，已实现计划的叶所汲取者合起来无重复，且在根的足迹之内（JointPlan.supports_of_realizes）；realized_requests_supported 即此定律（realized_requests_supported_by_core），无附加假设，公理报告为空（草稿构建；回执随落地）。逆向别无所加则不成立：无整体持有部分处，根的足迹可支持每一叶（Unjoined.supports_not_realizes），即本记录之限制在脊柱上的见证。realize_iff_supported 的列表模型与外围回执保持原范围。
history.en: 14 October 2026, integration I3 (Ren: “a lot proofs are probably not integrated”): stated on the spine. The new core module Becoming.Composition, importing only Becoming.Likeness, adds the relation by which a configuration holds two configurations together as its parts (JointFrame), with joint tests, joint likeness, compactness, nested plans and footprints; Becoming.CompositionBridge reads ExplanatoryJointness and ExplanatoryFootprints as instances. Where each part's footprint lies within its whole's and the two parts' footprints share nothing, what the leaves of a realized plan draw on, joined, repeats nothing and lies within the root's footprint (JointPlan.supports_of_realizes); realized_requests_supported is that law (realized_requests_supported_by_core), with no added hypothesis and empty axiom reports (scratch build; the receipt comes with the landing). The converse fails with nothing more: the root's footprint can support every leaf where no whole holds any part (Unjoined.supports_not_realizes), the record's limitation witnessed on the spine. The list model of realize_iff_supported and the periphery receipt keep their scope.

20 October 2026, R32 (forwarders, copies and reading modules: pure forwarders removed, statements stated once, reading modules folded into the module they read): Proof bindings (Composition.lean, JointPlans.lean) rebound to core receipt 20261019T231053.882924Z. Re-pointed after reading the change: Composition.lean, takes as its final section JointPlanFrames, the module reading it, folded in with declarations, names and statements unchanged; pure forwarders and copies removed where it had them; JointPlans.lean, pure forwarders and copies removed (B10, B9), uses pointed at the law they restate; imports follow the folds; kept statements unchanged. The claim is unchanged.
